publication: GitHub source repository and stable release
target: VICE Turbo6510 MOS8565 PAL x64; safe; Colodore/filter0; silent
protocol: 128 simulation-event warmup, complete 2048-tick route (~40.8 emulated seconds); count only completed new views, native trace/counter agreement; host time and warp excluded
nearContract: Plus 8 WU in all modes; Q8 1 WU. Legacy 8 WU in Modes1-6; Mode1 reference skips crossing segments. Legacy Mode7 clips at camera plane0, generated intersection/min face depth1, projection divisor minimum2. Clip FPS includes fully clipped/empty phases. No equivalence of near volumes is claimed.
mainFixture: Camera: 48-vertex torus; matched perspective: 24-vertex tilted torus, 48 triangles. Clipping: two adjacent double-sided triangles on Z=X+40. Lighting: 12-vertex 20-face icosahedron, same profile/input across comparable builds.
